verdicts.item:
4. A04-2, A04-4: After a failed run is captured, submitting the earlier implementation again runs
   admission over the grown corpus; it is activated only when it passes.
   [witness: verification:kernel_a04_resubmission_readmits_grown_corpus]
statements: A04-2: admitted <-> corpus != empty AND for_all case IN corpus: passed(case)

A04-4: submit(impl) AND verdict(impl, current_corpus) = admitted
         AND current_activation != impl  -> new Activation(by kernel)
verdicts.why: The check detects re-admission over the new two-case corpus, refusal and no activation for the crashing implementation, and a new kernel activation for the admitted earlier implementation when another implementation is current. It does not assert that every trial execution for the admitted implementation has outcome `passed`, so it only weakly establishes A04-2's admitted iff every corpus case passed.
